record.question: What is the purpose of making a 'Pharmacopoeia'?
options: To have an encyclopaedia of drug manufacturing
To have an official standard for the identity, purity, strength, and quality of medicines.
To collect information about drug indications, dosage and their potential adverse effects.
To collect information on the various sources of drugs for clinical trials
record.explanation: Answer B: To have an official standard for the identity, purity, strength, and quality of medicines.. A pharmacopoeia is an official compendium of standards for the identity, purity, strength, and quality of medicines and ingredients. Reference: https://ipc.gov.in/mandates/indian-pharmacopoeia.html; https://www.usp.org/about. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
